name: mirage
text: Understood, and written into the task list as CH73. Plan: one master switch, Run on: GitHub (the default) or Phone. In GitHub mode the phone only sends your settings and shows what the engine is doing. Every control becomes a control of the engine, including the Bids tab. In Phone mode the engine is shut down completely (off, trading off, bids taken down) and the phone runs everything itself. STOP ALL stays yours alone. Order: (1) audit what the phone still runs while GitHub drives, (2) move the leftovers to the engine or switch them off in GitHub mode, (3) add the master switch. Some things have to stay on the phone: your trading and management keys, Novig's stream under your key, and the one-connection sockets like Pinnodds. This is big, so I'll ship it as one release, with the Kalshi and bid fixes bundled in. I'll report after the audit.
